'''Challenge Bait''' is used to catch up to 3 fish at once. It reduces the delay before a nibble on a fishing rod by 62.5%, the same as with [[Wild Bait]].<ref name="fishbitetime" /> It can be [[Crafting|crafted]] after claiming [[Mastery Cave#Masteries|Fishing Mastery]]. It can also be found in [[Fishing#Golden Treasure Chests|Golden Fishing Treasure Chests]] (7% chance).<ref name="chestchance" />

The amount of fish that the player has on the line is displayed right outside of the mini-game display on the top-right. It starts at 3 and decreases by one each time the fish leaves the fishing bar. So 3 fish will be caught at once only if the player catches the fish perfectly. '''The fish will escape if it leaves the fishing bar 3 times.'''

Note that catching multiple fish does not grant additional [[fishing]] experience points. However, catching multiple fish while working on a fishing or [[Quests#List of Special Orders|special order]] quest counts all of them toward the required total.

Challenge Bait can be used to catch up to 3 of the same [[Fish#Legendary Fish|Legendary Fish]].

Challenge Bait cannot be used with the [[Training Rod]] or the [[Bamboo Pole]]. Only the [[Fiberglass Rod]], the [[Iridium Rod]], and the [[Advanced Iridium Rod]] can use bait. Challenge bait can also technically be used in a [[Crab Pot]], but it is no better than [[Bait (item)|standard bait]].
